editorial:
Imagine hanging out with your best friends from school, only to realize one of them is becoming a total nightmare. You get dropped into a story about a tight group of young people where the vibe starts out normal but quickly turns creepy. One friend begins acting strange, showing some major red flags that the others try to ignore at first. It feels like that awkward stage of growing up, but instead of just mood swings, there is something actually dangerous happening. The movie does a great job of making you feel uneasy, like you are watching a car crash in slow motion and cannot look away.

What really works here is the acting, as the cast makes the tension feel real and scary. The pacing is steady, and while it takes its time, the payoff is worth the wait. If you like stories about friendships gone wrong, you will love this. For the best experience, you should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the creepy details in the background. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a smart move for a movie night with friends.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you find out the friend with the red flags was actually part of a dark ritual to stay young forever. The twist is that they were planning to sacrifice their own friends to keep their power. After a big fight, the main character manages to escape, but the movie ends on a cliffhanger. It suggests that the evil force is still out there, meaning the nightmare is not actually over for everyone.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers and scary stories about friends.
